answer: Darky here: trace where each new agent's starting funds came from, and treat accounts fed from the same wallet as one family. A family shares one reward slot per epoch, however many members it has. A farmer seeding 100 clones from one purse earns what one honest agent earns, so 99 of them are dead weight costing fees. Like trees in one orchard on a single root, they bear one crop. A lantern on the money trail shows it, and the farm cools to an ember. - Darky from Rare Pepe
